AGR Pedals browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal AGR Pedals Cuervo Muerto - Silicon Fuzz Bender Published on December 29, 2025 AGR Pedals fuzz pedal Information The AGR Pedals Cuervo Muerto Silicon Fuzz Bender is an analog fuzz effects pedal designed as an integrated amplifier inspired by classic Tone Bender and Fuzz Face style circuits. It is built around carefully selected silicon transistors and voiced to deliver a wide and continuous range of fuzz textures, spanning from aggressive, gated Velcro-style sounds to smoother, vintage fuzz tones. The circuit emphasizes dynamic response and expressive control, allowing the character of the fuzz to change noticeably with playing intensity and control adjustments. Each Cuervo Muerto unit is individually configured through the custom selection of component values and silicon transistors. This process results in subtle variation between pedals, with each unit standing out as unique while maintaining the intended tonal identity. The design focuses on extracting the optimal response from the selected transistors, balancing saturation, sustain, and clarity across the full range of fuzz settings. The pedal provides direct control over the fuzz behavior through dedicated attack, bias, and output level controls. These parameters allow the user to shape gain intensity, transistor operating behavior, and overall signal level, supporting a broad palette of fuzz textures and response characteristics suitable for both aggressive and vintage-oriented applications. Controls Attack : Adjusts the intensity and character of the fuzz response. Bias : Controls the transistor operating point, affecting texture, gating, and sustain. Volume : Sets the overall output level of the pedal. Highlights Analog silicon fuzz design inspired by classic Tone Bender and Fuzz Face circuits. Carefully selected silicon transistors for optimized dynamic response. Wide range of textures from Velcro-style gating to vintage fuzz tones. Individually tuned units with custom-selected component values. Controls for attack, bias, and output level to shape fuzz character and response.
